verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a hosted REST API that runs tasks and agents on a cloud browser. The OpenAPI spec lists a POST /v1/run/tasks endpoint, and docs describe the flow as 'send a prompt and a URL, Skyvern runs a cloud browser, and you get structured output back'. Requests use API-key auth, and passing a webhook_url triggers a POST when the run reaches a terminal status. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented run-status polling endpoint (the API reference only says it covers 'runs') and independent hands-on corroboration of the API-plus-webhook flow.
